comparison.objective: Compress and fit a spring tension rod level between cupboard walls, versus adjust and lock a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-716 requires bimanual compression, spatial alignment, and controlled release under spring force; the candidate requires coaxial driver/wrench manipulation and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-716 requires both caps pressing the walls at the marked height while the rod supports itself; the candidate requires nut retention, target angle, and repeatable cycles.
comparison.reason: Both retain a released configuration, but the rod task tests spring-loaded placement rather than fastening an adjustable mechanism.
